description: A vibrant display of bananas and limes in a grocery store. The bananas are arranged in neat bunches on green shelves, with varying shades from green to ripe yellow. Each bunch is tagged with a small sticker. Below the bananas, a collection of fresh green limes is placed in cardboard boxes. The lighting highlights the freshness and vivid colors of the fruits, creating an inviting and organized presentation. The background is slightly blurred, focusing attention on the fruits.
